title: Hermes Skill Research Dataset Row
description: One row of a JSONL dataset of completed Hermes tasks used by the bounded Zeus research pilot.

schema_version.description: Dataset contract version. Must be exactly 1.

researcher_id.description: Stable identifier of the researcher that produced the candidate. Must not contain secrets.

task_id.description: Canonical task identifier (task_ + hex slug). No raw session ids in the key.

task_instructions.description: Task statement. Must be scrubbed of credentials/tokens/PII before writing.

skill_path.description: Path to the SKILL.md being researched. Must be an absolute /Users/... path, a ~/... tilde path, or a repo-relative skills/... path; in every form it must name a directory that contains a SKILL.md file.

before_session_ids.description: Hermes session ids that informed the candidate (the 'before' evidence).

after_session_ids.description: Optional follow-up sessions. May be empty.

blind_id.description: Blind label assigned by the harness before judging. Exactly A or B.

judge_model.description: Non-Zeus reviewer model id used for the blind A/B judge.

judge_prompt_hash.description: sha256 of the frozen, versioned judge prompt actually used.

candidate_patch_sha256.description: sha256 of the candidate patch content. Provenance handle only; never a verdict.
